status: M0 design draft; production checks not implemented
scope: Current audited macOS arm64 toolchain; serial stages; existing standard Cargo/pnpm caches; one active run; no minimum-space proof
formula: ceil(max(final allocated subtree, available subtree samples) * 1.5 / GiB), at least 1 GiB per grouped phase
stage_recheck: Before each long stage, sum budgets of this and remaining phases per destination volume, including cache volumes; do not subtract unverified cached artifacts. Stop if free bytes fall below the remaining reservation. Recheck before App/ZIP/extraction with the full delivery reservation. Changed source/toolchain or parallel jobs require new measurements.
limitations: Five-second samples are lower bounds, not true peak measurements; headroom is an explicit policy choice.
Swift grouped observation is final build+cache footprint; its prior sampling covered the whole experiment, not this subtree.
Cargo source footprint is a read-only measurement of resolved macOS dependency sources; empty global Cargo/pnpm caches were not measured. M7 must verify and revise this policy for that scenario.
Rust observation deliberately includes debug, tests and release; no claim that a package-only build needs this full amount.
Native observation includes a source copy also covered by locked_inputs; this double count is conservative.
The final delivery tree includes App, ZIP and extracted App; retained old delivery must be accounted separately if it exceeds this reservation.
